basic_info.description: This updated single-family home offers 2 bedrooms and 1 well-appointed bathroom with a large manicured backyard. Step inside and be greeted by an inviting living space, adorned with natural light and modern convenience. The functional eat-in kitchen offers sleek countertops, stainless steel appliances and ample cabinet space. The two spacious bedrooms look out to the backyard creating a serene tranquil environment. A highlight of this home is the usable backyard providing outdoor living space to entertain and relax. Downstairs you will find a versatile bonus room with washer and dryer. The large 1-car garage offers an abundance of storage space. Close proximity to shops and restaurants on vibrant Mission Street and Glen Park with easy access to freeways.
